note: String patches for prompt text tweakcc never extracted as fragments. Version-bound: minified identifiers (tXS, vgm, _i, Qs, xl, fu) change per CC build, so update-cc.sh must re-derive these against each new binary. Applied by tools/apply_adhoc.py after `tweakcc --apply` (which rebuilds from backup and would otherwise drop them).

patches.name: delegation-override-cut
patches.why: spec/10 item 6: the injected pair ('Do not call the AgentTool / workflows or deep-research unless the user requested it') contradicts the Agent tool description and duplicates the Workflow description's own opt-in gate. One owner, one statement. Early return also neutralizes the statsig override path (tengu_heron_brook), which could otherwise re-inject server-pushed text.

patches.name: bypass-auto-shell-block-invert
patches.why: spec/10 item 9: the shared template `o` (injected under bypass mode, auto mode, and the bashFirst flag) ordered cat/sed/heredoc editing over the dedicated Read/Edit/Write tools, against the harness fragment and Edit's read-before-edit precondition. Inverted, keeping only the token-cost intent (batching), so the mode headers above it stay coherent.
patches.oldShape: one template literal assigned to a minified variable (`o` on this build), five `${...}` interpolations in the order shell tool, three dedicated tools, shell tool again. Recorded by shape and digest rather than transcribed: the block is Anthropic's text, and a literal locator is the text it locates.
patches.oldSha256Note: SHA-256 of the literal's body with every `${...}` rewritten to `${}`, so the value survives per-build and per-platform minification. Identical on 2.1.234, 2.1.273 (linux-x64 and win32-x64) and 2.1.278. The executable locator is ccctl.SHELL_BLOCK_SHA256; `tools/build_ab.py` reproduces the exact bytes from a pristine binary.
patches.new: o=`Prefer the dedicated ${Qs}, ${xl}, and ${fu} tools as usual. Use the ${_i} tool to batch work when one invocation genuinely replaces several separate calls.`
patches.marker: batch work when one invocation genuinely replaces several separate calls
